$comment: contract-version 0.1.0 — initial object-store adapter contract. The provider-agnostic STORAGE ADAPTER surface: the operation set an adapter must satisfy, the backend selector (r2/s3/minio), per-backend addressing, and the DELIVERY MODE (presigned-direct vs platform-proxy) that lets a co-located per-tenant MinIO conform alongside a global presigned R2/S3. Foundation of the object-store contract family: contracts/workspace-data (snapshot protocol), contracts/data-migration, contracts/workspace-migration all consume THIS. Adapters (r2/s3/minio) are swappable behind it — MinIO 'and such' are just adapters.
title: Object Store (Storage Adapter) Contract
description: SSOT JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for the provider-agnostic object-storage adapter layer. Defines WHAT an adapter must implement (the operation set), HOW a backend is selected + addressed, and the DELIVERY MODE by which a workspace box moves bytes to/from the store — the dimension that makes both a global presigned R2/S3 and a co-located per-tenant MinIO first-class adapters. The SDK owns this SHAPE; the adapter implementations live in molecule-controlplane (internal/workspacedata S3Store + the backend selector); higher contracts (workspace-data, data-migration, workspace-migration) build on it. The workspace box NEVER holds object-store credentials — presigned-direct uses a presigned URL, platform-proxy uses the box's existing platform auth.

adapter_owner.description: Owns the adapter implementations (S3Store + the r2/s3/minio backend selection).

consumers.description: Contracts that build on this one.

operations.description: The adapter operation set — every backend adapter MUST satisfy these (the ObjectStore/Presigner interface in molecule-controlplane).

addressing.description: Per-backend S3-client addressing style + region convention (the SigV4 region is required even where the backend ignores it).

style.description: MinIO needs bucket-in-path unless wildcard DNS is configured (o.UsePathStyle=true).

region.description: A real AWS region from region_env; falls back to auto.

delivery.description: HOW a workspace box moves bytes to/from the store. This is the adapter dimension that lets a co-located per-tenant MinIO conform without exposing it to the network.

by_backend.description: Default delivery per backend. R2/S3 are a single GLOBAL store reachable from every box (presigned-direct); a per-tenant MinIO is co-located + loopback-only, so its bytes proxy through the tenant platform.

presigned_direct.description: The box curls a presigned URL the CP minted (the prefix + short TTL are the auth boundary). Requires the store be network-reachable from every box (a global R2/S3).

platform_proxy.description: The box streams to/from a tenant-platform route (reachable on the existing :8080 path — private-IP same-cloud, CF-tunnel cross-cloud); the platform reads/writes its OWN loopback MinIO. No new SG rule, no MinIO exposure, works cross-cloud, box stays creds-free (uses its platform auth token). Caveat: bytes transit the platform; cross-cloud rides the CF tunnel size/time limits.

config.description: CP-side endpoint/creds env (an Infisical projection); NEVER on the wire / never on the box. Per-usage keys with a fallback chain onto the workspace-data values so one endpoint+cred pair backs all three subsystems (only bucket names differ).

fallback.description: The relay + image-gen endpoint/creds default to the workspace_data values; only bucket differs.

creds_boundary.description: The load-bearing security invariant across BOTH delivery modes: presigned-direct → box holds only a short-lived presigned URL; platform-proxy → box holds only its existing platform auth token. Object-store credentials live CP-side / platform-side only. (This is why per-tenant MinIO removes the cross-prefix R2 bucket-policy prerequisite — the box's ECR principal never has standing on any store.)
